profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | CLI, Web & Platform Engineering | Heroku
profile.summary: I'm a Principal Software Engineer who has spent 10+ years at Heroku progressing from senior engineer to technical lead to principal, building deep expertise across the Heroku CLI, Dashboard, and developer tooling platform. I'm known for driving large-scale technical modernization, authoring architectural RFCs, and delivering measurable improvements to developer experience and system performance. I Bring a systems-level perspective to both hands-on engineering and cross-functional technical leadership.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Serve as architecture representative and technical owner for the Heroku CLI, MCP offering, and developer tooling platform — driving direction from architecture through hands-on execution and aligning across engineering, product, and design
* Lead and personally engineer major Heroku CLI releases — driving the modernization that brought the codebase up to current TypeScript and Node.js standards and delivering key customer-facing features — while owning release strategy, dependency security, and testingstandards across the plugin ecosystem — while delivering key customer-facing features and owning overall release strategy.
* Build CLI performance improvements by refactoring telemetry and implementing lazy-loading optimizations - Lead and hands-on deliver multiple infrastructure initiatives — overhauling CLI telemetry collection, migrating the department's error-tracking provider, driving testing overhauls, and maintaining dependency security across the plugin ecosystem
* Author architectural RFCs and drive their implementation, including a multi-year modernization spanning two tracks: SDK modernization (building a fetch-based API client through to a shared TypeScript SDK across the CLI, MCP offering, VS Code extension, and Dashboard) and CLI plugin standardization through design patterns, AGENTS.md, and monorepo consolidation
* Build and own the Heroku MCP offering — implementing features and its integration with the next-generation SDK, currently integrating the in-development SDK to modernize its API layer
* Champion AI-assisted development across the team — building purpose-built Claude Skills and agents, creating AGENTS.md to guide AI contributions, and sharing AI workflow techniques with colleagues
positions.insights: Claude Code Subagents, Web Applications and +13 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* As a lead engineer on the Heroku Dashboard team, owned major product areas of the web frontend and contributed across its supporting backend
services.
* Led cross-functional projects end-to-end with product managers and designers — scoping features, guiding the team through technical planning and
code review, and shipping to production.
* Delivered major product initiatives — including the GitHub App platform migration (legacy OAuth → repos-api, spanning PR fetching, branch management, and CI/Review Apps integration), Review Apps 2.0 (beta → GA), the scheduler/tasks UI, and the free-tier/Eco plan billing flow and enforcement.
* Drove department-wide modernization — bringing the Ember, Ruby, and Heroku platform stacks up to current versions across the web property fleet, and overhauling the test suite.
* Built out the operational experience (opex) area of the Heroku Dashboard, delivering metrics visualization (language-specific metrics for JVM, Go, and Node.js), autoscaling configuration, and alerting that gave developers real-time insight into their running applications.
* Mentored engineers on the team; established engineering practices and expanded scope over tenure to include CLI contributions and broader backend platform work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Shipped full-stack features as a hands-on individual contributor — writing and reviewing code daily and partnering with product managers and
designers — with occasional contributions to backend API development.
* Built the frontend for SSO and federated-identity sign-in flows.
* Delivered the Orgs/Teams product — fine-grained access control and self-serve org creation with integrated payments.
* Contributed to the metrics and autoscaling experience — building charting, language metrics, and alerting features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop and deliver software for SAAS-based continuous integration platform
* Lead effort to migrate to Single Page App model, architect supporting APIs
* Work on backend Ruby-based system modules to execute CI functions
* Spend time with Pivotal Labs to develop and institute effective team practices
* Work on small team to collaboratively prioritize and solve business and engineering challenges

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
* Develop and deliver software for Web Transactions team
* Work on variety Ruby on Rails based apps with a focus on licensing apps
* Work with SOAP, REST service endpoints
* Modern frontend development - HTML5, AJAX, responsive design
* Work with multiple UX, marketing, and business teams to develop and implement requirements

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Develop web applications for eCommerce platform
* Design, develop mobile eReader application for Android, iOS
* Shell scripting, data import and export
* Backend web service and data model development
* Translate graphic design work to frontend CSS/HTML/Javascript markup
